Name: Frame-Synchronous Metadata Wrapper TRE
Description: The Frame-Synchronous Metadata Wrapper TRE allows the data producer to associate other NITF TREs to a specific frame or consecutive range of frames in a temporal block (i.e., a NITF Image Segment). It is likely that data producers will choose to make use of NITF TREs that were developed before MIE4NITF. A NITF Image Segment containing a temporal block may contain multiple instances of NITF TREs that are meant to be associated with one or more frames in the temporal block, but lack any mechanism to do so. Wrapping these TREs in their own FSYNWA TRE provides an unambiguous association between the metadata contained in those TREs and the frame(s) in the temporal block to which their metadata applies. This mechanism also allows reuse of existing TREs without any modification to their structure needed.

START_FRAME_NUMBER.Name: First Frame Number
START_FRAME_NUMBER.Description: This field shall indicate the relative frame number of the first name associated with the encapsulated TREs.

END_FRAME_NUMBER.Name: Last Frame Number
END_FRAME_NUMBER.Description: This field shall indicate the relative frame number of the last frame associated with the encapsulated TREs. If the value of this field is zero, then the encapsulated TREs are associated with all frames from START_FRAME_NUMBER to the last frame in the temporal block.

CE_RETAG.Name: CE_RETAG of the nth encapsulated NITF TRE
CE_RETAG.Description: This field repeats once for each encapsulated TRE. The number of TREs is not signaled and is determined by parsing the TRE data.

CE_REL.Name: Length Field of the nth Encapsulated NITF TRE
CE_REL.Description: This field repeats once for each encapsulated TRE. The value 99,950 is the maximum TRE length possible. This may only be achieved if there is a single encapsulated TRE. The number of TREs is not signaled and is determined by parsing the TRE data.

CE_REDATA.Name: Data of the nth Encapsulated NITF TRE
CE_REDATA.Description: This field shall contain the data of the nth encapsulated NITF TRE.
